name: table
title: Table
description: Presentational native table anatomy for readable data grids and TanStack Table app-layer composition.

meta.customization: Customize the native anatomy through ui-table classes, shadcn-style data-slot values, and stable data-scope="ui-table" data-part hooks.
meta.api: Table exports TableContainer, Table, TableHeader, TableBody, TableFooter, TableRow, TableHead, TableCell, and TableCaption. Every part forwards native HTML props, class, children, and data-scope/data-part/data-slot overrides for app-layer wrappers.
meta.accessibility: The component preserves native table, caption, thead, tbody, tfoot, tr, th, and td semantics. Consumers own caption text, header scope, aria-sort, labelled regions, selected-row announcements, and any interactive controls placed inside cells.
meta.dataAttributes: Defaults use data-scope="ui-table" and data-part values container, root, caption, header, body, footer, row, head, and cell. data-slot values are table-container, table, table-caption, table-header, table-body, table-footer, table-row, table-head, and table-cell. App-layer components may override those attributes while retaining native elements and classes.
meta.state: No controlled or uncontrolled state. Sorting, filtering, pagination, selection, column visibility, and row identity belong to app-layer engines such as TanStack Table or to host application state.
meta.ssr: Renders deterministic native markup with no browser globals, effects, generated IDs, or hydration-sensitive state.
meta.limitations: Table is presentational source, not a grid engine. It does not implement sorting, filtering, pagination, virtualization, roving focus, column sizing, column reordering, row selection, or async loading policy.

parity.html: Keeps native table semantics as the contract: Keystone does not replace table markup with ARIA grid roles unless a future app component requires that behavior explicitly.
parity.shadcn: Matches the copy-paste anatomy shape and data-slot ergonomics in Solid source form, with Keystone tokens, compact styling, and a TableContainer part compatible with CardFrame table-container clipping.
parity.tanstackTable: The base parts are intentionally engine-agnostic and are consumed by the first-party DataTable kit, where TanStack Table owns row models, sorting, filtering, pagination, selection, and column visibility.
